item.description:
## Chart Builder Song charts are now a first-class window: Chart Builder button in the notation header, Shift-Command-N, or the Chart menu.
- Shift-click a run of bars, drag to an insertion line, drop to commit. One undo step. Grouped rests stay together. Left/right buttons move the same selection. - First and second time bars (volta brackets) with playback that takes the first ending, then the second. - Navigation marks: Segno, To Coda, Coda, D.S. al Coda, engraved with Bravura. - Full-depth repeat barlines, x1–x8 counts, and clearance so notes no longer crowd the marks. - Paste over the selected bar without changing chart length. - Screen and print use separate symbol scales so the in-app chart and the PDF can both read cleanly.
## Notation - Full-beat sixteenth-triplet groups now label **6**, not 3. Eighth and quarter triplets stay **3**. - Compact four-bar printed charts: shared staff geometry, engraved time signatures, smaller simile marks, larger rests, dotted-rest and flag spacing fixes.
## Already in 1.0 macOS 14+, 7-day trial, Lemon Squeezy licensing. This build is 133 (was 107).
